verdict.rationale: Sprinto exposes some API surface (Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, custom-integration push APIs, webhooks, integration monitoring) letting external systems push/pull certain data, but this is far from full UI parity — actions like access reviews, questionnaires, vendor risk assessments, task assignment, and audit workflows are documented only as dashboard/UI actions with no corresponding API endpoints shown, and a live probe for a public OpenAPI spec returned 404 on all candidate paths. missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/API reference covering core workflows (access reviews, questionnaires, task management, risk assessments) equivalent to UI capabilities, and independent confirmation that API coverage matches UI feature set.
